export function pixelChannels(hexColor) {
  const hex = hexColor.replace(/^#/, "").toLowerCase();
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]{6}$/.test(hex)) return null;
  const channels = [];
  for (let offset = 0; offset < 6; offset += 2) {
    channels.push(parseInt(hex.substring(offset, offset + 2), 16));
  }
  return channels;
}
